mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate revenues, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS exceeds 150k for three consecutive months (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 600k per month signals weakening consumer confidence and reduced durable goods demand, leading to lower corporate capital expenditures and weaker earnings expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 600.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production above 96.0 index level for two consecutive months indicates improving manufacturing output and supply chain resilience, which supports corporate profitability and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO > 96.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue visibility and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST < 600.0 and RSAFS < 380000.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction effect size (IC) < -0.04 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a decline in industrial production below 95.0 signals a tightening monetary policy that suppresses corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and INDPRO < 95.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction IC < -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 8.5% and decline in non-farm payrolls below 132000k signals a deteriorating labor market, reducing household income and consumer spending, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 8.5 and PAYEMS < 132000.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction IC < -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 380000 million dollars combined with a drop in housing starts below 600k signals a collapse in consumer demand, reducing corporate earnings and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS < 380000.0 and HOUST < 600.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction IC < -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
